mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees and clear near the Verona Public Library, though we do have an air quality alert with an index of 57.

The city recently closed entries for the I Voted sticker contest where K-12 students submitted original designs to be used for the November election, and residents can vote for their favorites between July 28 and August 7. Also, residents are reminded to prepare their mailboxes for the winter season by checking that they meet current United States Postal Service specifications to avoid damage during plow operations.

We have plenty of local fun ahead, including live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow and trivia nights throughout early next week.
In a look at the weekly report, on July 13, a 36-year-old man from Madison was arrested for an O-W-I after officers responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock.
Culver's is serving up Chocolate Volcano today and is open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
